slides.texte_overlay:
habits of people who
never seem stressed

they leave early

they leave ten minutes before they need to. when you're never rushing, a huge amount of small daily stress simply disappears before it can ever reach you.

they learn for fun

they spend a few minutes a day on something that has nothing to do with work, and it keeps them calm. curiosity gives an anxious mind somewhere gentle to go when work gets loud.
slides.texte_sophia:
they learn for fun

i spend 5 minutes a day on something that isn't work: a myth, space or a painting. i do it with the Sophia app, and it gives my mind a calm break from every worry.

slides.texte_overlay:
they say no politely

they turn down what they don't have time for, kindly and without long excuses. a free calendar is one of the quietest secrets of people who always seem calm.

they write everything down

they put their tasks and worries on paper instead of carrying them in their heads. when your brain doesn't need to remember everything, it finally relaxes.

they move every day

they walk, stretch or exercise a little every single day. moving your body burns off stress hormones and leaves you noticeably calmer for hours afterwards.
